deepseek_v41.mapping_corner_scope: Qwen retained parent uses historical TT mapping/ot_hdc_fadd; DS retained parent maps SS/LAT7. Actual historical cell counts are not a TT per-unit arithmetic extrapolation and are not current repaired-target closure.
